title: Celsius to Fahrenheit Converter
description: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit using the standard formula.
code:
celsius = float(input("Enter temperature in Celsius: "))
fahrenheit = (celsius * 9 / 5) + 32
print(f"{celsius}C is equal to {fahrenheit}F")
expectedOutput: Enter temperature in Celsius: 100.0C is equal to 212.0F
